description: This file is a shell script for testing git-svn interactions with branch names containing unusual or 'funky' characters, including URL-encoded branch names and special characters. It sets up an SVN repository with complex branch names and runs Git commands to verify handling of these names.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects the given commands to succeed, used multiple times to string together test steps.

methods.name: maybe_start_httpd
methods.description: Starts a local HTTP server to serve the SVN repository if required.
